body:
## Goal

Infinite scroll with a counter that never lies.

The API exposes **no total** — no pagination header, no `_meta`, nothing. "Page 1 of 64" is
therefore unrenderable, and any number resembling a total would be invented. This issue exists as
much to enforce that honesty as to load more rows.

## The counter contract

| State | Shows |
|---|---|
| Still loading pages | `250 items loaded…` — what we have, stated as partial |
| Last page reached | `2,059 items` — now a real total, because we counted every one |

Never interpolate, never estimate, never show a progress bar against an unknown total
([PRD](docs/product/prd.md) R2.5, R9.3).

## Requirements

- Reaching the bottom loads the next 50 through `upstream/paging.rs`. The front end never computes a
  page number.
- Server-side sorting by name, size, and date; changing sort restarts the walk.
- Type filters — video / subtitle / archive / other — by **file extension**.
- Rapid scrolling must not issue duplicate requests for the same page.

## Done when

- [ ] Scrolling to the bottom appends the next page
- [ ] The counter switches from partial to total only on the real last page
- [ ] Changing sort or filter restarts cleanly with no rows from the previous ordering
- [ ] Tests cover both counter states and the no-duplicate-request behaviour

## Verify

```bash
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
```

## Human acceptance

Open `FOLDERID1`, scroll to the end, and confirm the counter settles on exactly **2,059** — the
measured truth. A different number means the clamping trap is live somewhere in the chain.

## Docs to update (CLAUDE.md §4)

- [ ] `docs/architecture/runtime.md` — the paged browse flow
- [ ] `docs/product/prd.md` — tick R2.4, R2.5, R2.6, R2.7
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` — M0 completes with this issue

Depends on #6

body:
## Goal

Make the tree walkable: paste a link, descend into folders, come back out.

- A link input accepting every form `parse_link` handles, reachable with `⌘L`
- Clicking a folder row descends into it
- Clickable breadcrumbs, each returning to that level
- Back and forward, matching the shortcuts the platform already uses

## Requirements

- Fetched pages cached so revisiting a level is instant, with an explicit refresh available.
- Navigating away mid-fetch cancels that fetch rather than letting it land on the wrong screen.
- A folder that fails to load shows the reason in place, with a retry — never a hidden log
  ([PRD](docs/product/prd.md) R9.4).

## Done when

- [ ] All four link forms navigate correctly from the input
- [ ] Descending three levels and returning through breadcrumbs lands on each correct level
- [ ] Back and forward traverse the same history
- [ ] Component tests cover breadcrumb construction and history behaviour

## Verify

```bash
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
```

## Human acceptance

Paste `https://upstream.example/folder/FOLDERID1?token=1755000000` and
`https://mirror.example/FOLDERID2`. Both list. Descend three levels, return via each
breadcrumb, and confirm every level is the one it names. This is an M0 exit criterion in
[product/roadmap.md](docs/product/roadmap.md) and cannot be settled by a test.

## Docs to update (CLAUDE.md §4)

- [ ] `docs/architecture/runtime.md` — **create it.** §4 binds any runtime flow to this file, and
      browse-and-descend is the first flow that exists
- [ ] `docs/README.md` — move `architecture/runtime.md` from Pending to Written
- [ ] `docs/product/prd.md` — tick R2.1 and R2.3

Depends on #6

body:
## Goal

`the file table component` — the virtualised list that has to stay smooth at 2,059 rows, because
`- - a large folder` really does hold that many and it is the folder the user opens most.

Columns: name with a type icon, size, date. Row actions appear on hover so the table stays calm.

## Requirements

- TanStack Virtual. [CLAUDE.md §6](CLAUDE.md): long lists must be virtualised.
- Type icon resolved from **file extension**, never `mimetype`.
- Sizes rendered human-readably from `u64` bytes, with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so
  columns of digits line up.
- Multi-select: checkboxes, `Shift+Click` for a range, `Cmd/Ctrl+A`.
- Rows for `.iso` and `.rar` show a disabled play control with the reason *"ISO files must be
  downloaded before watching"* — never an error after a click.
- Loading renders skeletons that preserve layout. No full-screen spinners.

## Done when

- [ ] Renders 2,059 real entries fetched through `list_folder`
- [ ] Component test asserts only a bounded number of rows are in the DOM at once
- [ ] Selection state and its total size are exposed for the sidebar to use later

## Verify

```bash
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
```

## Human acceptance

Open `FOLDERID1` and scroll the full 2,059 rows. Scrolling must stay smooth with no blank
frames, and memory must not climb with distance scrolled. No test can settle "smooth", which is why
this carries `needs-human` and must not be closed automatically.

## Docs to update (CLAUDE.md §4)

- [ ] `docs/product/prd.md` — tick R2.8 once demonstrated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`

Depends on #5
